note: Scripture authority is the Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (OLCB 2017, Biblica, cc-by-sa; ebible mirror bibles/lug_bib, all 66 books on disk). Wesley quotes the KJV constantly and mostly without citations; the reference list is the union of the references identified for the shipped es/am/fr editions (same block structure), re-measured against this text.

A `mined` row was measured against the finished text: every verse of the reference has an exact substring of at least 25 characters of its OLCB wording inside that block. Shorter, paraphrased, re-personed or KJV-shaped quotations (Wesley often quotes loosely or merges verses) are self_rendered in OLCB's register.
